file: 429 Undertale Was Made Almost Entirely by One Person.mp4

lines.t: Undertale was made almost entirely by one person.

full.credit: Clips: Stega; Shirrako; Havoc teh Rabbit (YouTube)

lines.t: In June 2013, Toby Fox asked Kickstarter for five thousand dollars to make it.

full.credit: Clips: Stega; Shirrako; Havoc teh Rabbit (YouTube)

lines.t: Two thousand three hundred ninety eight people gave him over fifty one thousand. Ten times his goal.

full.credit: Clips: Stega; Shirrako; Havoc teh Rabbit (YouTube)

lines.t: Apart from some art by Temmie Chang, he made the whole game and its music himself.

full.credit: Clips: Stega; Shirrako; Havoc teh Rabbit (YouTube)
